title: The six digit code

beats.say: Mum says aunty sent her a code by mistake. She wants it back.

screen.title: Mum
screen.body: Beta Sharma aunty ne galti se 6 number ka code bhej diya, wapas maang rahi hai. Bhej doon?

beats.say: It's just a number! Totally harmless!
That code is Mum's house key. Aunty didn't drop it. A stranger is asking for it.
Don't send it. Turn on two step verification.

screen.title: For Mum
screen.body:
1. Never send the WhatsApp code. Not even to aunty. Call her instead.
2. WhatsApp > Settings > Account > Two-step verification > Turn on.
3. Pick a 6 digit PIN only you know.
4. Lost money? Call 1930 or go to cybercrime.gov.in

screen.title: Mum
screen.body:
Beta Sharma aunty ne galti se 6 number ka code bhej diya, wapas maang rahi hai. Bhej doon?

Ho gaya beta. PIN 123456 rakha, yaad rahega.

beats.say: Her new PIN is one two three four five six.

caption:
a 6 digit code from 'sharma aunty'. one reply and mum's whatsapp belongs to a stranger.

never send your whatsapp code to anyone, even a friend. call them instead.
then lock it: settings > account > two-step verification > turn on, and pick a PIN only you know.

which scam should mum ask about next? one word.
